name: dynshells
description: THE SHELLS LINKED DYNAMICALLY (shared libc SP5 step 3).  ldd runs each shell's binder in full and shows it resolved against libc.so and libtermlib.so.  Neither shell references a libfgx export, so the dynamic link drops libfgx.so and no `-lfgx.1' line may appear.  Control: a pile or static binary makes ldd say `statically linked', which is what vi and tcsh answered before they were linked by fgx_dyn.  ldd prints a shell's name before it runs the binder, so a failed bind shows in what follows it: a library the binder cannot find prints `not found' (and exits 0), and an image that does not load makes ldd print `execution failed'.
